about: The OTS Enforcement Order Archive the OCC keeps (https://occ.gov/static/ots/enforcement/ots-enforcement-order-listing.xlsx): each order against an institution, with its docket, number, day issued, kind, the institution's town, its file on occ.gov and the archive's note; 2050 orders against persons left out. A federal agency's own work (17 U.S.C. § 105). Written by `npm run sync:ots-orders` (batch 154) for lib/otsOrders.ts.
